After Daniel was purchased by Fluor Corporation in 1977, he was named president of Daniel in 1982, and became chief executive officer, as well as a director on Fluor Corporation's board of directors in 1984. In 1986, the engineering, construction and maintenance capabilities of Fluor and Daniel were joined together in a new company called Fluor Daniel.
